summary: NavCloud debug singleton (client-only registry row). Registered by bg3.exe+0x65F740 (size 0x30, align 0x30 in the packed word 0x300030) with destructor thunk_FUN_140582AD0 = the destructor of a HashSet with plain (trivially destructible) keys; its default constructor bg3.exe+0x6A2DB0 zeroes the HashSet shape. No system of bg3.exe, of the Toolkit DLLs or of the macOS build reads or writes it (macOS has only its ComponentOps), so the key type is unknown and the set is written as its raw members (Script Extender HashSet layout, CoreLib\Base\BaseMap.h: StaticArray<int32_t> HashKeys, Array<int32_t> NextIds, Array<TKey> Keys). Never seen alive.
